integrity: Analytical proof with independently executable finite-state checks; no external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected simple graphs, deterministic global Poisson resetting, fixed particle count, rate-one edge exchanges. The high-reset criterion is sufficient rather than necessary; no full general-graph sign classification or thermodynamic limit is asserted.
title: A local-neighbor covariance reversal criterion and a sharp bipartite threshold for exclusion with resetting
